title: Pop-Up Star Wars & Superhero Con: Free Springfield, Missouri Event
seo_title: Pop-Up Star Wars & Superhero Con in Springfield, MO
description: This is a pop-up Star Wars and superhero convention with free photo ops with Santa Claus and the Grinch, free 9"x12" prints for sharing the event on social media, a Saturday ugly Christmas sweater contest, and a Sunday cosplay contest (cosplay is optional). Admission is free, with optional VIP tickets for $15, and it is for all ages. It runs Friday, December 11, 2026 at 5:00 PM through Sunday, December 13 at 6:00 PM at University Plaza Hotel & Convention Center, 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy in Springfield, MO; reservations are only needed for VIP tickets, and hotel parking is $10 per day with free parking available downtown.
